title: Dolce & Gabbana Beauty plots double-digit growth and up to 70 boutiques
summary: CEO of Dolce & Gabbana Beauty Gianluca Toniolo has outlined plans for the Italian luxury fashion brand’s beauty business to expand its retail footprint with up to 70 independent boutiques worldwide as it targets double-digit growth in 2026
